metadata.title: That 1 kill where I pressed random buttons and Valorant said ‘Sure, why not?’
metadata.description:
Clicked like I was daydreaming.
Enemy probably uninstalling to rethink life choices.
Valorant’s logic: handing out freebies like it’s a glitch day.
Click if your aim took a nap but the game still loves you!

Tap if your best kills were pure accidents too!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
